title: Chapter 435
paragraphs: Chapter 435
125. Attackers, Brothers (3)
Suddenly, the air in the middle of nowhere split apart, and Mort revealed itself through the gap.
"Uh, what is that?"
"What's with the toad...!?"
The Tona brothers cried out simultaneously. Mort's huge white body cast a shadow over the Tona brothers and the assassins' boats.

Although they yelled, the brothers knew that the toad Mort was the familiar of the Ice Bow Lord. It was just that seeing it in person for the first time and given the situation, they instinctively cried out.
The assassin captain, who was confronting the brothers with his face hidden under the hood, also widened his eyes.
'Ice Bow Lord, Talaris Endorma...!?'
For Groser, there was no way to know why that monster came here.
He hadn't heard the story about the Tona brothers from the elders in the first place, but that was a manageable variable.
But if it was Talaris, it was a different story.
The Abyss Spider was the common nickname for Talaris among the saints. However, very few people knew exactly why that nickname was attached.
Rather, looking at the elements that make up Talaris and the Ice Bow, such as the 'lonely tower in the West Sea,' 'the ice,' and 'the winter,' other nicknames would be more fitting.
So, many saints thought that the dark and fearful image created by the words "Abyss" and "Spider" was not the reason, or it symbolized her enormous male harem.
The assassin and Talaris' gazes collided. To him, the sight of Mort descending seemed like an extremely slow-motion scene.
From the assassin's perspective, it felt like the literal end of the world was descending upon him.
Squeak, crack, sizzle!
Before Mort's huge four legs touched the seawater, a sound of something rapidly freezing and shattering spread.
It was the sound of the sea around Tikan freezing.
White frost from Talaris spread over the sea like a spider's web.
The pouring downpour froze, and the waves subsided.
The waves didn't completely stop but soared wildly into the sky, riding on the cold.
In less than 5 seconds, the frozen waves became huge enough to cover Tikan, creating a kind of protective barrier. It was enough to cover the 'entire island.'
The sky was darkened by the ice blocking the view, but the Ice Bow in Talaris' hand was shining with cold and aura.
"Huh, this stupid toad. It should have arrived at the mansion inside the island, not here."
[Booong...]
Talaris scolded Mort while shrugging her shoulders. As she said, they originally intended to enter the mansion inside the island, but Mort made a mistake and fell onto the sea.
Fortunately, it turned out to be a great stroke of luck for the Tona brothers.
"Ma, youngest!"
The Tona brothers shouted simultaneously.
It wasn't just Talariis riding on Mort; Jin, Murakan, and along with the Hidden Palace 7 Swords, Syris was also riding on Mort.
"Well, you did well, Mort. It's not an entirely inappropriate location."
[Bo-ong!]
"Those clumsy guys were trying to fight for our son-in-law, huh? Hehe, admirable."

As Talariis spoke, the assassin suddenly threw himself at the Tona brothers. They were just exchanging blows a moment ago, and the distance was very close. The assassin intended to suppress the Tona brothers and use them as hostages.
If Jin had come alone, it would have been difficult to block. The distance was that short.
However, Talariis blocked the assassin's approach to the Tona brothers with just a light gesture, without even taking her feet off Mort's back.
Swoosh! Fwoosh!
Following Talariis' gesture, an ice pillar rose between them. The assassin desperately swung his sword, but he couldn't break the ice, and the Tona brothers quickly moved towards Mort.
"That's rude, interrupting people when they're talking."
"Brothers, are you alright?"
The Tona brothers nodded vigorously.
Seeing their appearance, Jin couldn't help but feel a strange mix of emotions and pride in them.
'In my previous life, they used to torment me... but now, they tried to fight to protect my comrades.'
At a glance, the enemy was someone the Tona brothers couldn't handle. Yet, the two didn't back down and tried to fight.
"We're fine!"
"Thanks to you coming."
The Tona brothers replied with revived spirits.
Drip, drip!
The raindrops turned into hail due to the cold, and the sound of it incessantly striking the ice curtain was pleasant.
'If I were just a bit late, it would have been hard for the brothers to survive.'
There would be enemies inside Tikan, and it wouldn't be possible for all of Jin's comrades to be unharmed. Civilian casualties would have been enormous.
If it wasn't for Hidden Palace, Jin would have arrived here only after the terror had ended.
-My lord, the weather and air currents in the Tikan area are not good, so we cannot use the moving gate.
-...Hidden Palace! What about the gate to Hidden Palace?
The conversation Jin had with the butler, Petro, just before coming to Tikan.
Hidden Palace was in a state where instant movement between the gates of Runcandel was possible, and fortunately, Jin was able to ask Talariis for help.
Thanks to the 'hotline' of Hidden Palace's public agent, the Seven Colored Bird, Lucas Manfran, Talariis was already aware of the situation just before Jin arrived.
Even if Jin hadn't come in person, Talariis would have moved Mort to help Tikan.
From the moment Talariis showed the seal of 'Elona Gipul', or even from the moment she noticed Jin.
Hidden Palace was Jin's strongest ally.
"Daughter."
"Yes, mother."
"Go with your son-in-law and protect the interior of the island with the Hidden Palace 7 Swords."

"Understood. Hidden Palace 7 Swords, let's move inside quickly! The goal is to protect Tikan's forces and civilians, and try to suppress the enemy if possible, but don't put too much restriction on killing."
"By your command!"
"My darling. No, how about our handsome brother transforms into his true form and takes a look at the battlefield?"
[I was about to do that anyway. But who are you calling my darling?]
"Hehe, a slip of the tongue."
Murakan transformed, revealing his black and enormous wings. Jin climbed onto him and reached out to the Tona brothers.
"How about you guys also ride and help me out?"
The Tona brothers replied with their expressions.
Wow, can we really ride on the back of the magnificent Black Dragon? That kind of expression.
However, instead of letting the Tona brothers ride on his back, Murakan held them in his mouth.
[Don't even think about riding on my back. I'll drop you guys off at an appropriate place, so get ready, got it?]
Hoo-woong! Murakan flew up, and as Syris and the Hidden Palace 7 Swords headed inside on Mort, only Talariis and the assassin were left outside.
"Do you want to surrender and die painlessly, or struggle and die brutally? I hope you're a friend who can choose wisely."
Talariis aimed her ice lance as she spoke. With her appearance, the assassins had practically lost the option to return alive.
The assassin adjusted his stance.
An extraordinary aura emanated from him as well. Although his light was dimmed due to facing Talariis, he was by no means a nameless warrior who would fade into oblivion.
"…How could the Hidden Palace Lord move for the likes of Runcandel's 12th generation?"
"Should I take that as choosing the latter?"
Whack!
Talariis slid on the ice and charged, swinging her ice lance. The assassin blocked the strike and scattered sword energy.
Of course, Talariis hadn't put all her strength into the first strike, but she didn't expect the assassin to block it so cleanly.
"Our son-in-law said before coming that the elders' council must have hired you guys. I thought it would be the Black King's group or Amella's mercenaries, but it doesn't feel like that at all?"
Talariis had experienced numerous battles with the Black King's group and Amella's mercenaries in her youth. The patterns shown by them and the assassin's sword were completely different.
However, the sword gave a feeling much more familiar than the Black King's group or Amella.
"Sal-su, have you seen me somewhere before? I can smell a familiar scent."

Although Sal-su was having a fairly plausible exchange with Tal-lar-is, he didn't have the luxury to respond to every remark. Sal-su was putting in his full effort, while Tal-lar-is was effortlessly handling him.
"I'm getting a little curious. Why don't you kindly tell me which group you belong to?"
As Tal-lar-is increased the tempo, Sal-su's movements became increasingly unstable.

Above the sea, Tal-lar-is, armed with ice, was an invincible warrior. With the physical abilities of a top 10-star knight and the power of ice sprouting from all directions, Sal-su was being pressured relentlessly.
Whack!
Soon, Tal-lar-is's sword aura grazed Sal-su's right cheek. The wind caused his hood to fall, revealing his face, which even Tal-lar-is couldn't help but be taken aback by.

His facial skin hung down, almost covering his eyes, his lips were nearly gone, and his ears were completely crushed and unrecognizable. The rough, grinding sound of his breathing indicated he had respiratory problems.
Hissing, hissing, hissing...!
Sal-su gasped for breath, and Tal-lar-is stopped attacking to stare intently at him.
Between the ruined mess of a face, there were fleeting glimpses of a familiar appearance.
"You... No way."
Tal-lar-is's pupils widened. He remembered who Sal-su was. More precisely, he remembered Sal-su's 'affiliation.'
"Aren't you a Runcandel Execution Knight? You've all attacked me together before."
As if he understood, Tal-lar-is nodded.

"Ah, you're not an Execution Knight now, but an exile, judging by your face. No wonder your swordplay was unusual. Yes, it's clear. I remember clashing swords with you long ago. You were the leader of the first-tier Execution Knights back then. Your name was..."
"I have no name."
"Why not? It feels like I should remember."
Rrrrip! Sal-su tore off his hood, turning it into a mask, and spoke.
"Anyway, since you've come for us, none of us can survive. Whether we die painfully or peacefully, do as you wish."
Sal-su's sword, once again filled with energy, emitted intense heat.
And looking at Sal-su, Tal-lar-is smiled wickedly.
"Why should I kill you? If possible, I'd rather keep you alive."
"What are you talking about, Lord of the Ice Palace?"
"I think our son-in-law might find a use for you. For now... pray. Pray that those inside haven't harmed our people."
If they have, even if I want to spare you, I won't be able to. As Tal-lar-is added, he unleashed cold air on Sal-su.
